title: Edits of the inputs of a model's runs
description: An edit sets an input of a model for its runs (napkin/model/runs.py). An input is named by its full path: member.input, where a member is an entity, a member written by hand or a row of a table by its id (sites.clinic.level); Template.instances.input for every member of a template; or input for an input of the top level. `set` edits every run, `options` the runs that take an option, and `runs` one run. The narrower edit wins: one run, then one option, then every run; every edit wins over the value that an option of the run gives and over the model's own. At each level a line of one member wins over a line of every member of its template, and two edits of options that one run takes may not set one input. A value follows the input's type: a number in the input's own unit, true or false for a yes/no, or a text: a number with its unit ("3 days"), a member of the input's enum, a text for a text input, or a distribution written as in a model, with numbers for its arguments ("pert(48 h, 96 h, 200 h)").
